4/S0.subgoal: Describe the content and goals of the lecture on VR and AR definitions.

4/S1.subgoal: Explain the dictionary definition of virtual reality and its three primary components.

4/S2.subgoal: Describe the three defining characteristics of a VR system in detail.

4/S3.subgoal: Explain how to use the three characteristics to identify a VR system.

4/S4.subgoal: Identify whether various technologies are VR systems by applying the three defining characteristics.
